author: Tesla
description:
Tesla's Controller-Hardware-In-the-Loop (CHIL) is key to bringing Megapack sites online faster
 
CHIL allows us to simulate the entire site in real time before it’s connected to the grid. We can see how the site will respond to faults, frequency changes or if a tree were to fall on a power line. 

CHIL validated 444 grid-forming Megapacks at Melbourne Renewable Energy Hub before grid connection, delivering 600 MW / 1.6 GWh of storage months ahead of schedule".
